correctness.rationale: For trees the determinant D(t)=det(I-tA) is the matching polynomial with positive value for 0<t<1/rho(A). Multiplying the resolvent by D gives numerator coefficients N_v(t)=sum_{k<n}(sum_{j<=k} d_j (A^(k-j)1)_v)t^k. The exact rational barrier R>=1/rho maps t=R x/(1+x) to x>0; uniform transformed coefficient signs certify no zero or reversal on the entire admissible interval. Independent exact test on nonisomorphic trees n=2..8 reproduced edge totals 1,2,6,12,30,66,161 and precisely two uncertified/reversing edges, both on n=8. Independent rational-adjugate evaluation and max row sums of A^4 verify signs at (1/3,3/7) and (1/4,1/3) strictly inside admissible intervals. Complete Prüfer and canonical-tree method supports exhaustiveness; this does not imply for general graphs.
